name: Network Topology Graph
grain: one versioned node-edge network
relationships: nodes connect edges
edges reference restrictions resources and modes

name: Origin Destination Flow Cube
grain: origin-destination-commodity-mode-period cell
relationships: cells aggregate shipments and map to network zones

name: Order Shipment Graph
grain: connected order-shipment-consignment-equipment-party graph
change_semantics: append events plus versioned business objects
relationships: orders allocate to shipments; consignments use equipment and legs

name: Traceability Event
grain: one object event at a business step and disposition
relationships: events reference object lists locations transactions sources and destinations

name: Process Execution Trace
grain: one lifecycle event per case/activity
relationships: events form partial orders and correlate to planned model

name: State Transition History
grain: one object state transition
relationships: transitions obey a versioned state machine

name: Resource Calendar
grain: one resource-availability interval
relationships: resources carry skills capacities and eligibility

name: Constraint Profile
grain: one constraint applicable to an entity or movement
relationships: constraints bind resources routes cargo and time windows

name: Alternative Decision Set
grain: one feasible alternative with objectives and violations
relationships: alternatives reference assignments routes schedules and interventions

name: Demand Forecast Distribution
grain: entity-horizon-quantile forecast
relationships: forecasts reconcile across hierarchies and scenarios

name: Service Promise
grain: one contractual or published promise per item/journey
relationships: promises attach to orders shipments trips or bags

name: Eta Distribution
grain: one prediction vintage per milestone and quantile
relationships: milestones form route precedence and connections

name: Trajectory
grain: one time-ordered track point or segment
relationships: track relates moving object to network and business leg

name: Route Plan
grain: one ordered route leg and stop
relationships: legs connect locations use modes and assigned resources

name: Queue Episode
grain: one entity arrival-start-service-end-departure episode
relationships: episodes consume servers and precede downstream events

name: Capacity Profile
grain: resource-time bucket by nominal usable and committed capacity
relationships: capacity is consumed by assignments and constrained by calendars

name: Inventory Snapshot
grain: item-location-lot-disposition-as-of row
relationships: snapshots reconcile to movement events and holds

name: Inventory Movement
grain: one quantity movement or adjustment
relationships: moves link source and destination locations and documents

name: Warehouse Task
grain: one directed handling task lifecycle
uncertainty: shared work and missing start time
relationships: task uses worker/equipment and moves inventory between locations

name: Labor Shift Task
grain: one pseudonymous worker shift-task segment
relationships: workers perform tasks under skill and ergonomic constraints

name: Equipment Sensor Series
grain: asset-sensor-observation row
relationships: sensors observe assets environments or cargo

name: Alarm Fault Event
grain: one alarm activation acknowledgment clear or reset
relationships: alarms relate to sensor series and maintenance work

name: Maintenance Work Order
grain: one maintenance work order with status history
relationships: work addresses defect/failure and consumes resources/parts

name: Failure Censoring Record
grain: asset exposure interval ending in failure or right censoring
relationships: records link failure mode maintenance and operating context

name: Inspection Checklist
grain: one inspection item observation and disposition
relationships: defects may block asset use and create work orders

name: Safety Incident Hazard
grain: one incident/near-miss/hazard with causal and corrective-action graph
relationships: events link conditions barriers causes consequences and actions

name: Package Scan Event
grain: one item or handling-unit scan
relationships: items nest in handling units and traverse facilities

name: Postal Quality Sample
grain: one test-item or RFID observation within a measurement design
relationships: sample observations estimate product-lane populations

name: Address Delivery Point
grain: one versioned address/delivery-point candidate
relationships: address maps to access point road segment zone and service product

name: Driver Duty Log
grain: one ELD duty-status and edit/certification event
relationships: events allocate driver and vehicle to regulatory clocks

name: Vehicle Telemetry Trip
grain: vehicle signal observation within reconstructed trip
relationships: trip links route load driver and stops

name: Traffic Segment Series
grain: road segment-direction-time-bin observation
relationships: segments connect network graph and incident overlays

name: Weigh In Motion Observation
grain: one vehicle pass with class axle and weight features
relationships: observation map-matches vehicle class to road lane

name: Fuel Emissions Ledger
grain: vehicle/vessel/leg/fuel-period activity and emissions row
relationships: ledger allocates fuel/emissions to assets legs cargo and customers

name: Train Timetable Path
grain: one train path occupancy by infrastructure element
relationships: path reserves blocks platforms and junctions

name: Train Consist
grain: versioned ordered locomotive-wagon consist
relationships: train contains locomotives wagons loads and blocks

name: Rail Control Intervention
grain: one signal/PTC/interlocking warning enforcement or override
relationships: event relates train position authority signal route and operator action

name: Ais Track Message
grain: one AIS message or quality-filtered position
relationships: MMSI crosswalks to vessel voyage and port call

name: Port Call Milestone
grain: one requested planned estimated or actual port-call event
relationships: milestones form precedence across arrival berth services and departure

name: Berth Window Assignment
grain: one vessel-call berth/time assignment alternative
uncertainty: arrival service-time draft and weather uncertainty
relationships: assignments consume berth channel tug pilot and crane resources

name: Terminal Yard Inventory
grain: one container/equipment-to-yard-slot position as of time
relationships: equipment occupies slots and has cargo/visit associations

name: Cargo Handling Cycle
grain: one CHE handling cycle decomposed into travel lift wait and set-down
relationships: cycle moves cargo between locations under work instruction

name: Stowage Load Plan
grain: one cargo-unit to vessel/aircraft/vehicle position assignment
relationships: assignments obey stability segregation sequence and connection constraints

name: Trade Declaration Release
grain: one declaration item and authority decision history
relationships: declaration relates goods consignments parties permits and transport

name: Transport Document Lifecycle
grain: one waybill/bill/booking document version and status
relationships: document references parties cargo equipment legs and contracts

name: Flight Leg Milestone
grain: one planned estimated target or actual flight-leg milestone
change_semantics: retain prediction revisions and adjudicated actual
relationships: milestones connect tail crew airport and passenger/cargo rotations

name: Airport Resource Assignment
grain: one flight-to-gate/stand/runway/resource interval assignment
relationships: assignments share passenger baggage fueling towing and safety constraints

name: Turnaround Activity Trace
grain: one ground-handling activity milestone
uncertainty: manual status and cross-handler clock skew
relationships: activities form precedence network determining TOBT readiness

name: Baggage Custody Event
grain: one bag acceptance load transfer unload or delivery event
relationships: bag events relate passenger itinerary flight and container

name: Air Cargo Object Graph
grain: ONE Record logistics object and event subgraph
change_semantics: linked-data updates with version and access policy
relationships: shipment pieces ULD booking waybill events and actors interlink

name: Transit Timetable
grain: one trip-stop-time service-date planned call
change_semantics: full feed versions and calendar exceptions
uncertainty: published schedule differs from dispatch plan
relationships: trips use routes stops calendars shapes and transfers

name: Transit Realtime Entity
grain: one TripUpdate VehiclePosition Alert or SIRI delivery entity
change_semantics: incremental or full dataset semantics; archive polls
relationships: entities reference schedule trip stops vehicles and situations

name: Fare Tap Journey
grain: one pseudonymous fare validation and reconstructed journey leg
relationships: taps associate fare products stations/trips and transfer chains

name: Passenger Load Stop
grain: vehicle-trip-stop board/alight/load observation
relationships: stop loads reconcile across trip and passenger demand

name: Shared Mobility Trip Event
grain: one MDS device status or trip event
relationships: events relate devices trips geofences and policies

name: Gbfs Availability Snapshot
grain: one station/vehicle availability at feed poll
relationships: availability maps vehicles/stations to service system

name: Curb Rule Activity
grain: one curb regulation interval or observed use activity
relationships: activities are tested against overlapping rules permits and zones

name: Disruption Scenario
grain: one scenario containing initiating events propagation assumptions and interventions
relationships: events disable/degrade resources and propagate across network dependencies

name: Simulation Event Trace
grain: one replication-entity-state-transition event
relationships: trace links simulated queues resources decisions and outcomes

name: Causal Hypothesis Graph
grain: one versioned causal variable mechanism intervention and evidence edge
uncertainty: confounding selection measurement and transportability uncertainty
relationships: causes precede effects; interventions target manipulable nodes

name: Conformance Deviation
grain: one alignment deviation between observed trace and allowed process/model
change_semantics: append detection and resolution; model version pinned
relationships: deviation references expected and observed activities constraints and actors

name: Data Quality Lineage
grain: one dataset-field-transformation-quality assertion
relationships: derived outputs link transitively to raw sources and decision runs
